name: TotpVerifier
purpose: Generate and verify six-digit time-based one-time passwords per RFC 6238 with constant-time comparison, clock-skew tolerance, and replay prevention.
api_signature:
from typing import Protocol

class TotpVerifier(Protocol):
    def provision_uri(self, account: str, issuer: str, secret: bytes) -> str: ...
    def verify(self, secret: bytes, code: str, last_used_step: int | None) -> int: ...
invariants: Shared secrets MUST be ≥160 bits drawn from a CSPRNG and MUST NEVER be transmitted outside the enrollment channel.
verify() MUST compare codes in constant time and NEVER short-circuit on prefix match.
Accepted skew MUST be bounded to ±1 step (±30s); larger windows SHALL be rejected by configuration.
A successfully used step number MUST be recorded and the same step CANNOT be accepted again for the same secret.
Codes SHALL be six decimal digits derived from HMAC-SHA1 truncation per RFC 4226; alternative digit counts MUST be explicitly opted in.
extension_contract: Alternative HOTP/TOTP schemes (SHA-256, 8-digit, custom step) register as verifier adapters implementing the Protocol and declaring their digest and period. The registry rejects adapters that skip replay-step persistence.
consumption_example:
def confirm_mfa(totp: TotpVerifier, user, submitted_code: str) -> None:
    next_step = totp.verify(secret=user.totp_secret, code=submitted_code, last_used_step=user.last_totp_step)
    user.last_totp_step = next_step
    repo.save(user)

sources.locator: Sections 4 and 5 TOTP algorithm and security considerations

why_essential: Every service that keeps TOTP reimplements the replay-step check and skew window; centralizing the verifier eliminates off-by-one-step bypasses and the classic 'accept any code in the last 10 minutes' bug.
alternatives_considered: SMS OTP only — phishable and deprecated for high-assurance in SP 800-63B.
Email magic link — couples MFA to mailbox security and adds latency.
Per-service TOTP library call — no shared replay protection.
